owner_order: Owner 2026-11-01: comparison examples to evaluate over time; this register is their home. Entries are evaluated on accrued evidence, never on preference; a verdict requires the entry's review point + data, else the entry stays open.
method: Observational over time with pre-named responses per entry. Fleet work generates the evidence as it runs (each skill authored/loaded, each competition routed). Designed sub-studies may be spun out per entry by amendment when observation is too slow. Verdicts use the family rule: winner is cherry-picked into the default; no_selection stays a lawful outcome.

entries.question: Skill packaging format: directory + SKILL.md vs single-file *.skill — which serves the fleet better over time?

arms.skill_md: Directory-canonical format (SKILL.md + sibling assets). Incumbent: 41 in termux-monorepo .agents/skills/*, registry docs/ops/SKILLS-INVENTORY.md; /opt/muse/skills + ~/workspace/custom-skills run on it; Agent Skills standard (Anthropic -> Linux Foundation) is this shape.
arms.dot_skill: Single-file *.skill package. Challenger: no fleet usage yet; appears in external ecosystems/imports.

responses: collision/clobber incidents (evidence: the stepie-stepwise-ops salvage, 2026-10-20 — a 101-line SKILL.md extract nearly clobbered the 478-line canonical; format-shaped risk, logged for skill_md)
cross-surface portability (which agent surfaces can consume each shape unchanged)
asset carriage (multi-file needs: scripts, fixtures, references)
evidence_sources: fleet skill authoring/loading incidents as they occur
external *.skill artifacts when imported or evaluated
entries.review_point: first 10 scored observations across arms, or a *.skill adoption proposal — whichever first

entries.question: New-competition routing: dedicated side chat via a Competitions Opportunity manager channel vs folding the opportunity into the existing Challenge Management oversight (9cb1c873) — which routes opportunities to action better over time?

arms.dedicated_channel: New Competitions Opportunity manager chat (created 2026-11-01) takes intake/evaluation; graduates entries to Challenge Management oversight.
arms.fold_in: Opportunity handled inside the existing oversight chat (the D-slate baseline pattern).

entries.first_instance: .approxination (owner, as-given 2026-11-01: 'We're competing in .approxination') — routed via the dedicated_channel arm; the D-slate history is the fold_in comparison record.
responses: time from opportunity-named to first action
entries.review_point: after 3 opportunities routed via dedicated_channel, or the .approxination outcome — whichever first
